He is of extraordinary activity apart from the activity of creation etc. He cut off the head of Brahmā. He is his father as well as his son. He is the progenitor and son of Viṣṇu to whom he controls. He is engaged in the worship of Śiva. May he grant my desire at the behest of Śiva.
